c6:gaziantep house.aciklama: This is a museum about the Whirling Dervishes. It's housed in a fine mansion, and shows displays. It is part of a mosque's "külliye" (Islamic-Ottoman social complex centered around a mosque). It was built in the 17th century. The Mevlevi Lodge Monastery is entered via a courtyard which opens off the courtyard of the mosque. Elsewhere I found it probably belonged to the Tekke Mosque, The mosque was built in 1638 by a Turkmen landowner, Mustafa Aga.

It was built in the 17th century. The Mevlevi Lodge Monastery is entered via a courtyard which opens off the courtyard of the mosque. Elsewhere I found it probably belonged to the Tekke Mosque, The mosque was built in 1638 by a Turkmen landowner, Mustafa Aga.

c6:anatolian garden.aciklama: In a village, Fasıllar, a monument from the 13th century BC that was never finished lies on a hill. It’s Turkish name is “Kurt Beşiği” (Wolf's Cradle), although it has nothing to do with wolves. A well-carved Storm God stands with his left leg on the head of the Mountain God. Thew latter stands between two lions. It is one block of rock of about 70 tons, its height is 8 meters and its width is 2.75 meters. A replica stands in the garden of the Ankara museum.

c6:elmalı.aciklama: Südöstlich von Yakaçiftlik liegt an der Straße von Elmalı nach Finike der Yakaçiftlik Düdeni, der zweitgrößte Ponor des Elmalı-Beckens mit einer Wasseraufnahmekapazität von 5 m³/s

In 1030 m Höhe über dem Meeresspiegel liegt südöstlich von Yakaçiftlik an der Straße von Elmalı nach Finike der Yakaçiftlik Düdeni, der zweitgrößte Ponor des Elmalı-Beckens mit einer Wasseraufnahmekapazität von 5 m³/s.

Dating back to the 4th century BCE, the rock-cut tombs line the hills above Myra’s famed theater and the Church of St. Nicholas. c6:güllük street.aciklama: Gulluk Mountain National Park. Some roads are short, some are long, but eventually the road will end. Take care of the roadsides, you will never see them again.

Termessos was a Pisidian city built at an altitude of more than 1000 meters at the south-west side of the mountain Solymos (modern day Güllük Dağı) in the Taurus Mountains (modern day Antalya province, Turkey). It lies 30 kilometres to the north-west of Antalya. It was founded on a natural platform on top of Güllük Dağı, soaring to a height of 1.665 metres from among the surrounding travertine mountains of Antalya, which average only 200 metres above sea level.

cf:File:Once upon a time, the Fisherman'.aciklama: This photo was taken by me in the Summer of 1981. At the time, this antique fisherman's warf was surrounded by the ruins of the ancient walls from the roman era dated back to 100 BC . This place was used to be the part of the Apollon Temple in Side, Turkey. It is hearthbreaking to see how it looks today. (Geography 36°45'54.7"N 31°23'09.1"E)

c6:lpg gas pump.aciklama: LPG Bullets The Bullets, named because of their shape stored Liquefied Petroleum Gases. LPG is the generic name for commercial Propane and commercial Butane. The two smaller vessels V1085 and V1086 stored Propane and were designated as emergency vaporisers for the Refinery Fuel Gas Main. V1092 and V1093 stored a combination of Butane and Propane which was pumped to process units to be separated. V1094 the furthest of the vessels was converted to be a buffer vessel for the Refinery Fuel Gas Main.

c6:red tower alanya historical tower.aciklama: The Kizil Kule (Red Tower) The octagonal shaped building that's the symbol of the city is a work by Selcuks of the 13th century. cf:File:Sillyon Kent Kapısı.jpg.aciklama: Sillyon’un ana kent kapısı, antik şehrin savunma sisteminin en önemli parçasıdır. Yaklaşık M.Ö. 4. yüzyıla tarihlenen bu kapı, Hellenistik Dönem'de inşa edilen ve Roma ile Bizans dönemlerinde onarılan sur hattına entegredir. Konum: Güneydoğu yamacında, şehre ulaşan ana yolun sonunda yer alır. Mimari: Kesme taş bloklarla inşa edilmiştir. Duvar kalınlığı ortalama 1.8–2 metreyi bulur. Savunma Detayı: Ana kapının hemen arkasında z-kıvrımlı geçiş yer alır; bu, saldırılara karşı savunmayı kolaylaştırı

cf:File:Hoa tưởng niệm gốc cây 55.jpg.aciklama: Remembrance flowers placed by local residents around a tree at the site of a traffic accident in Hanoi. c6:kemer municipality.baslik: File:Višnjica Spring Dabrica settlement Bosnia and Herzegovina.jpg
c6:kemer municipality.aciklama: The photograph depicts a wide shot and the structural design of the Višnjica spring in Dabrica. In the foreground is a massive stone vault (volt), a traditional architectural element built from hewn stone to protect the spring from sunlight, contamination, and external elements. This type of covering allowed for the preservation of lower water temperatures and quality during summer months. Connected concrete troughs forming a functional unit for water distribution are also visible.

There are some others here that look like they could be from the original Roman temple. The Kesik Minare Cami (a.k.a. Broken Minaret Mosque, Korkut Cami or Cumanın Cami) is in the heart of Kaleiçi on Hesapci Sk.
